title: scripts/substrate/ingest-docs-as-concepts.ts asserts TWICE (header line 8, and line 146) that docs-align-scan.ts dense-s
description: scripts/substrate/ingest-docs-as-concepts.ts asserts TWICE (header line 8, and line 146) that docs-align-scan.ts dense-searches source_type=doc_expectation to find which docs 'expect' a landed code change -- described as 'the dynamic doc<->code tie'. FALSE: docs-align-scan.ts contains zero concept-db references; it scans an in-memory corpus handed to it by docs-align-tick. A grep for doc_expectation across repos/ and scripts/ returns only ingest-docs-as-concepts.ts itself (lines 8, 146, 157): it WRITES the field and nothing anywhere READS it. Repair is either direction -- implement the tie in docs-align-scan, or correct the two comments -- but the claim and the code must stop disagreeing. CLASS NOTE: the docs_align_scan accuracy invariant structurally cannot catch this, because the scanner reads only .md files and never source comments; a checker that covers source-comment claims about sibling modules does not exist. FALSIFIER: a reader of source_type=doc_expectation outside ingest-docs-as-concepts.ts, or the comments no longer making the claim.
